MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Maritime Operations and Seamanship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Marine Operations and Seamanship 4.3 Marine Resource Utilisation 4.4 Blue Econom and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Safety of Humans and Equipment Undertaking Marine Activities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Marine Resource Utilisation 4.4 Blue Economy and Marine Entrepreneurship Page 12 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
